title: A wolf pack with minds (harness check)
about: Animals with minds: the subject is the island's bold pack of four (LIVING_ONLY names all four); the mind routes them through the models file's species map (think: ministral, remember and compile: ministral-14b). The authority asks an animal's mind only while a person is within 25 tiles, so the pack is set down 20 tiles from a Brackenford resident.
